Ashford Community Bank — Elm Road Branch
Attention, Safe Deposit Box Customers

Over the next two months, the Elm Road branch will be renovating its lower level, where
our safe deposit boxes are currently kept. Beginning on September 8, all boxes will be
moved to a new secure room on the first floor, next to the customer service desk.

Customers will not need to do anything during the move, and the contents of each box
will remain sealed at all times. However, the boxes cannot be accessed from September 8
to September 10. Starting on September 11, customers will receive a new key card for
the secure room on their first visit. Please bring photo identification with you.

Questions may be directed to branch manager Lydia Ferris at 555-0162.

대여 금고 이용 고객 여러분께 알립니다

앞으로 두 달 동안 엘름 로드 지점은 현재 대여 금고가 보관된 지하층을 개보수합니다. 9월 8일부터 모든 금고는 1층 고객 서비스 데스크 옆에 있는 새 보안실로 옮겨집니다.

이전 기간 동안 고객께서 하실 일은 없으며, 각 금고의 내용물은 항상 봉인된 상태로 유지됩니다. 다만 9월 8일부터 9월 10일까지는 금고를 이용하실 수 없습니다. 9월 11일부터 고객께서는 처음 방문하실 때 보안실용 새 카드 키를 받으시게 됩니다. 사진이 있는 신분증을 지참해 주십시오.

문의 사항은 지점장 리디아 페리스(555-0162)에게 해 주십시오.

questions.q: At 3:06 P.M., what does Ms. Hayes most likely mean when she writes, "Then let's work with what we have"?

She wants to cancel tonight's special.
She will order from a different supplier.
She expects the correct delivery to arrive soon.

유형: PART 7 · 의도 파악

It is located next to the restaurant.
It will not make another delivery today.

정답 근거: 정답 포인트 — 지문 "Their next truck won't come until tomorrow morning" → 보기 "It will not make another delivery today" (다음 트럭이 내일 아침 = 오늘은 더 배송 없음)
오답 분석: (A) 가격 인상 언급 없다. / (B) 위치 언급 없다. / (D) invoice라는 단어는 있지만 한 달에 한 번 보낸다는 말은 없다. 지문 단어로 만든 함정.

questions.q: At 9:43 A.M., what does Ms. Brooks most likely mean when she writes, "That's why I'm asking"?

She needs Mr. Serrano to call the Whitmans.

해석: 오전 9시 43분에 브룩스 씨가 "그래서 여쭤보는 거예요"라고 쓴 것은 무슨 의미이겠는가?

오답 분석: (A) 취소가 아니라 3시 30분이라는 다른 시간을 제안한다. / (B) 휘트먼 부부에게 전화하라는 요청 없다. / (D) 장소 얘기 없다.

questions.q: What will Ms. Brooks send to the Whitmans?

A revised service contract
Directions to the office
A list of retirement plans

Halden Textiles Returns to Millport

(Millport, May 18) — Halden Textiles, a maker of high-quality wool blankets and scarves,
will reopen its factory in Millport this autumn. The company moved most of its production
overseas eleven years ago, but rising shipping costs and longer delivery times have led it
to bring some of that work back home.

The factory on Weaver Street has been empty since the move. [1] Halden plans to replace
the old machinery with modern equipment that uses less energy and water. Once the
upgrades are complete, the facility is expected to employ about 150 people. [2]

Hiring will begin in July. Halden will give preference to applicants who live in Millport
and the surrounding towns. [3] The company is also working with Millport Technical
College to offer a free twelve-week training course for new employees with no previous
experience in textile production.

"Millport is where our company started in 1962," said chief executive Martha Halden,
the founder's granddaughter. "It feels right to come back." [4]
